summary: Caches an input SOP over previous frames to preserve history, connect temporal meshes/polygons, or compute point velocity attributes.
common_gotchas: Non-integer increments are risky with Particle SOP or Spring SOP sources.
Cache size must cover the requested length and increment.
Timeline jumps and reset pulses are visible because Trail SOP is stateful.
Mesh and polygon connection modes assume stable point counts across cached frames.
key_concepts: Trail SOP caches input SOP geometry over previous frames.
It can preserve trails, connect history as mesh, connect as polygons, or compute velocity.
Particle SOP and Spring SOP inputs need integer increments for reliable trails.
cache controls how many frames of history are retained, and reset clears cached geometry.
